title: Fix Illegal GUIDs in Grasshopper Components
description: Replace illegal GUIDs (containing non-hexadecimal characters like 'G') with proper generated GUIDs in Compose.Grasshopper.cs. The error occurs at line 6624 in ApplyKitDiffComponent.get_ComponentGuid() with GUID "B8F4C762-692F-4696-9EBD-243G21CE98GD".
summary: Replaced the illegal GUID "B8F4C762-692F-4696-9EBD-243G21CE98GD" (containing non-hex 'G' characters) in ApplyKitDiffComponent with a proper generated GUID "B7104D9E-E2BD-4FBE-9D04-A4527B978AEE". No other illegal GUIDs were found in the file.
